pairs: And when the Sabbath had passed,
Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James,
et Salome emerunt aromata ut venientes ungerent Jesum.
and Salome bought aromatic spices, so that when they arrived they could anoint Jesus.
And very early in the morning, on the first of the Sabbaths,
And they said to one another,
Quis revolvet nobis lapidem ab ostio monumenti?
“Who will roll back the stone for us, away from the entrance of the tomb?”
And looking, they saw that the stone was rolled back.
For certainly it was very large.
Et introëuntes in monumentum viderunt juvenem sedentem in dextris,
And upon entering the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side,
You are seeking Jesus of Nazareth,
Behold, the place where they laid him.
dicite discipulis ejus, et Petro, quia præcedit vos in Galilæam:
tell his disciples and Peter that he is going before you into Galilee.
For trembling and fear had overwhelmed them.
And they said nothing to anyone.
But he, rising early on the first Sabbath,
from whom he had cast out seven demons.
Illa vadens nuntiavit his, qui cum eo fuerant,
She went and announced it to those who had been with him,
while they were mourning and weeping.
upon hearing that he was alive and that he had been seen by her,
Post hæc autem duobus ex his ambulantibus ostensus est in alia effigie,
But after these events, he was shown in another likeness to two of them walking,
as they were going out to the countryside.
And they, returning, reported it to the others;
et exprobravit incredulitatem eorum et duritiam cordis:
And he rebuked them for their incredulity and hardness of heart,
because they did not believe those who had seen that he had risen again.
Euntes in mundum universum prædicate Evangelium omni creaturæ.
“Go forth to the whole world and preach the Gospel to every creature.
Qui crediderit, et baptizatus fuerit, salvus erit:
Whoever will have believed and been baptized will be saved.
Yet truly, whoever will not have believed will be condemned.
Now these signs will accompany those who believe.
They will speak in new languages.
and, if they drink anything deadly,
They shall lay their hands upon the sick,
Et Dominus quidem Jesus postquam locutus est eis,
And indeed, the Lord Jesus, after he had spoken to them,
and he sits at the right hand of God.
with the Lord cooperating and confirming the word by the accompanying signs.
